name: Default
shortDescription: Browser editor for Mermaid diagrams with real-time preview, SVG export and shareable links, served as the official static web build.

alerts.message: Diagrams stay in the browser and in share links, not on the server. The published image is built with upstream defaults, so the PNG/SVG and Kroki export links, Save to Mermaid Chart and Repair with AI send the diagram to hosted third-party services when used.
